title: With Cache Components, an AWAITED fs read is treated as uncached data
statement: With cacheComponents enabled, a Server Component that reads an artifact with `await readFile()` is treated as uncached data — it must sit within `use cache` or behind a Suspense boundary, and a fresh request after an external write returns the new value.
notes: Split from AST-0007 on 2026-08-18 before validation.
